name: Create and retain a custom language test
description: Verifies a user can create a prompt test and find it after refreshing.
steps: Enter a test title and prompt
Refresh the page and select the test
expected: The saved test remains in the suite with the selected language and prompt.

name: Block live testing without endpoint credentials
description: Verifies a request is blocked if the user has not provided an authorised HTTPS endpoint and key.
expected: A clear validation message requests the gateway URL and API key; no model response is displayed.

name: Show an authentication error from the gateway
description: Verifies an upstream 401 is shown without exposing the entered API key.

body_json.message: N-ATLAS rejected the supplied credentials. Check the API key and endpoint.

steps: Enter a valid-looking HTTPS gateway URL
expected: An authentication error asks the user to check the key and endpoint; the API key is not shown.

name: Export the reusable test suite
description: Verifies the current test cases can be exported for review and reuse.
expected: A JSON file downloads containing the current test titles, languages and prompts.
